name: Freshly Cut Weld
description: The 'welded shut' cabinet's seam was cut with a tool, cleanly and recently, not decades ago.

name: Sealed Settlement Copy
description: A copy of a confidential settlement that names Dr. Holt as personally negligent -- the exact contents of the missing file, according to Nathaniel's notes.

name: Surgical Glove
description: A single latex glove dropped near where Nathaniel was found, a brand still used at Dr. Holt's current private practice.

name: Dusty Visitor Log
description: An old sign-in sheet with one very recent entry, the ink still legible where every other line has faded.
